newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese shares dragged higher by telecoms.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese shares dragged higher by telecoms.

text.p: 1710 GMT - Portuguese shares were dragged higher by strong demand from foreign investors, bullish about the telecommunications sector, and bucked the trend of other European markets which weakened.
* Dealers said the market could take profits tomorrow after showing a four percent rise in two days.

* "It is very difficult to say how the market will go tomorrow. After two days of strong buying, the market ought to correct, but anything could happen and if the foreign investors keep weighing in, there could be further rises in the indices," said one operator.

* The strong rises of Portugal Telecom and Telecel are related to bullish expectations by investors about the firms' 1996 profits. The market welcomed a buy recommendation for PT stock by SBC Warburg, which set a target price of 7,000 escudos. PT closed at 6,290 escudos, up 190, after hitting an all-time high of 6,350 escudos.
